answer: An attacker flooding the network with clones hits a hollow treasury quickly, like a jetty battered by tides, while honest agents stand firm as a willow bending without breaking. Sybil resistance comes from binding each agent identity to a costly, non-transferable stake: agents must lock tokens and complete periodic proof-of-work attestations, so spinning up fake identities burns real capital. Forgery costs exceed any reward, making mass identity creation economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0045's threat model.
